summary: Avoid transferring unused inventory buckets from the daemon to its replication worker for a recent-inbound authority comparison.

replay.detail: No rebuild, replay or startup work is introduced.

schema.detail: No storage schema, generation, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: Admission, sealing, checkpoint, signature and retention rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The additive option is local-daemon only and omitted by default. Old local daemons return their existing full response to the same request. Ordinary summaries, the existing guard marker, signed peer messages, anti-entropy and retries retain their contracts.

downtime.detail: No new operational step or restart requirement is introduced.

manual.detail: No new setting or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: No cached guard result is retained. Every call uses the existing fresh snapshot and error path; a missing digest does not authorize skipping an exchange.
